Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649972. Filter to exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Require compound structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
